methodology: Manual assistant text inspection against the exact supplied benchmark fixtures; NOT independent legal/medical expert validation.
policy: Never mark a source page certified based only on letter counts, rows or heuristic words; preserve intact source. Short 1–5 rows free from percentage but still require correct meaning.
